body: U+0023# 2026-09-30: lab sweep of the combined PRs (#244 + #245 with rays + #246)U+000AU+000AThe full report is in ~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/E2E-REPORT.md, section "Impeller round sweep (VM lab)". Evidence is in testkit/results/lab-2026-09-30/.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Combined code:** the full suite passes (30 folders), `test/impeller` passes on both engines, and analyze is clean.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Live in the lab, pass:**U+000AU+002D **10.1, night mountains:** fixed on Mac Impeller and on Android OpenGL ES.U+000AU+002D **10.12, loading text:** only the loading line while the scene builds; the waiting line appears with the scene.U+000AU+002D **10.13, unknown mood:** a sprout, logged once, and exported unchanged as `loved`.U+000AU+002D **10.15, window clearance:** the full-screen title clears the window buttons.U+000AU+002D **Upgrade surfaces:** `file_picker` 13 export, `share_plus` 13 share sheet, `camera_macos` as a Swift package, the notification prompts on macOS and Android 17, photos, notes and shortcuts.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Lab before → after:**U+000AU+000A| | Mac VM | Android emulator |U+000A|---|---|---|U+000A| Frame rate | 9–12 → 60–62 fps | vsync-locked on both |U+000A| Scene ready | 1.45–1.83 → 0.45–0.73 s | 1.41–1.98 → 0.53–0.87 s |U+000A| Longest frame | still over 100 ms in 2/12 cases | still over 100 ms in 6/12 cases |U+000AU+000AU+002A*Open, needs the owner:**U+000AU+002D Flutter 3.47.5 macOS Impeller garbles glyphs intermittently when the GPU lags. It is seen in the baseline and in the sweep, so it comes from the engine: flutter/flutter #184091, fixed by #188965 on master for 3.48 and in no stable release.U+000AU+002D Whether it happens on real Macs is unverified.U+000AU+002D It bears on #244's switch of macOS to Impeller.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Seen once, not reproduced in 4 retries:** Android onboarding stalled after the notification Allow.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Lab bug found and fixed** by the "Sandboxed VM environments for testing" session: macOS modifier keys were being dropped.
